messages:
maria: Heads-up — Orion Health wants a 2-week private POC. Requirement: Redwood Private deployed in their VPC, but all root key material must remain in their on-prem HSM (PKCS#11). They will not allow plaintext export. Can we do a broker/agent pattern for the POC?

sam: Yep we can. Two realistic options for the POC: 1) local agent in customer VPC that exposes a KMIP/PKCS#11 facade to Redwood control plane over mTLS; 2) short-lived JWT-based signing where the HSM signs CSRs and we never receive private key. Recommend option 1 for quickest infra parity.

nina: Network notes: we'll need outbound mTLS from the broker to our control plane endpoints (443) OR we peer. Customer prefers no peering. Broker will need to fetch model blobs from s3 endpoints — either via VPC endpoints or proxy. Firewall ports: 443 outbound + NTP.

oliver: Security checklist: we need HSM vendor and model, attestation capability, signing algorithm (RSA vs EC). Also require audit log forwarding (syslog or securely pulled). How will rotation work? Do they want CA rotation handled in-house?

alice-cust: We have Thales Luna and an air-gapped appliance. Cannot allow outbound from the HSM. We can spin up a small bridge VM that has PKCS#11 driver attached to HSM and can accept requests from Redwood's broker within the VPC. Bridge VM will be controlled by our infra team.

sam: That works. POC pattern: customer deploys bridge VM (VM-A) in their subnet with PKCS#11 access to the HSM. We provide a lightweight agent (redwood-kms-proxy) that runs on VM-A. It exposes a local gRPC endpoint secured with a short-lived mutual TLS cert we provision (CSR signed by their HSM). Redwood control plane will mTLS to that agent. Agent calls into HSM via PKCS#11 for actual key operations.

maria: Quick example of the CSR flow we discussed (customer generates CSR via HSM and uploads):

```
# on customer bridge VM (example)
pkcs11-tool --module /usr/lib/softhsm/libsofthsm2.so --login --keypairgen --key-type rsa:2048 --id 01
# generate CSR with key id 01, CSR stored to /tmp/redwood-agent.csr
# Upload CSR to redwood console or paste into secure form
```

sam: After we receive CSR we sign an intermediate cert that the agent will use for mTLS to the control plane. Important: we never request private key export. For the POC we set cert TTL to 8h and automate renewal via a simple cronjob on the bridge.

oliver: For acceptance criteria we need: (1) proof that private key operations never leave HSM (PKCS#11 calls only on bridge), (2) attestations for the HSM or vendor-signed report, (3) audit logs from bridge forwarded to us for the POC window, (4) agreed rotation schedule.

raj-cust: Attestation: we can provide vendor attestation PDF and syslog access to the bridge. Rotation: we prefer 30-day key rotation for intermediate certs, HSM root stays in-house.

nina: Operational tasks for POC
- customer: provision bridge VM + PKCS#11 driver + route to HSM
- redwood: provide agent binary + CSR signing endpoint + example systemd unit
- both: test mTLS handshake and a sample signing call

sam: sample systemd unit for the agent (drop into /etc/systemd/system/redwood-kms-proxy.service):

```
[Unit]
Description=Redwood KMS Proxy
After=network.target

[Service]
Type=simple
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/redwood-kms-proxy --pkcs11-module=/opt/hsm/lib/libvendorpkcs11.so --listen=127.0.0.1:8443 --cert=/etc/redwood/cert.pem --key-slot=01
Restart=on-failure

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
```

maria: POC timeline suggestion: 2 weeks. Week 1: networking+bridge deploy + basic handshake. Week 2: workload simulation, logs & attestation review, sign-off. Pricing: we treat as standard POC (free) but if we need dedicated eng time for >10 days we bill at daily rate (TBD).

oliver: Also need NDA addendum for HSM attestation artifacts and log access. I'll draft a one-pager.

deploy-bot: ticket #POC-5023 created: "Orion Health — private POC BYOK HSM bridge" assigned to sam, nina. ETA 2024-11-08.

alice-cust: OK — we will stand up the bridge VM tomorrow and share access to a temporary admin account for the deployment window.

sam: Great. Action items: 
- sam: send agent binary + install instructions (today)
- nina: network checklist and sample firewall rules (today)
- alice-cust: create bridge VM + attach HSM slot (tomorrow)
- oliver: draft NDA addendum (EOD)

maria: Thanks all — will follow up in next standup. :thumbsup:
